parameters.name: SourceImageType
parameters.description:
The type of image 1. Valid values:

- **FacePic**: A face photo of the user.
- **IDPic**: A headshot photo from the chip of the user's second-generation ID card (typically read and decoded by a second-generation ID card reader device).

parameters.name: SourceImageValue
parameters.description: The URL of image 1. For more information, see the description of image URL upload.

parameters.name: TargetImageType
parameters.description:
The type of image 2. Valid values:

- **FacePic**: A face photo of the user.
- **IDPic**: A headshot photo from the chip of the user's second-generation ID card (typically read and decoded by a second-generation ID card reader device).

parameters.name: TargetImageValue
parameters.description: The URL of image 2. For more information, see the description of image URL upload.
